title: KAITO — A Reassuring Smile〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Suzurangumi Actress A
rows.Line: <Let us go together! To the place where the white roses point!>

rows.Speaker: Suzurangumi Actress B
rows.Line: <Yes, I feel that we'll be able to go anywhere together.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, I liked that last part...
I'll rewind it to... Here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Morinomiya really knows how to produce good dancers. Everybody's moving in lockstep.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I've watched this a number of times already, but I keep finding these little things that they've clearly worked very hard on to perfect.
KAITO☆
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, are you watching that Morinomiya DVD again?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You've been glued to it ever since Rui came over and lent you that DVD player.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm yet to get tired of it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get what you mean!
They're such amazing singers and dancers☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, I have to think that KAITO is the most obsessed out of all of us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, KAITO, you had Morinomiya on your mind even before you got your hands on this DVD.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, ever since Tsukasa and the others told us about it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I couldn't help but wonder what their shows are like since their troupes only consist of men or women.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now that I've actually seen a few, they've completely blown away my expectations.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It was so different seeing women playing male characters and vice versa!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But the women playing male characters look so cool while doing it♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I was stunned by how beautiful the men playing female characters looked.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's also interesting how the impression a character gives off can vary so drastically based on the performer's gender.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That must be one of the biggest reasons why their fans can't get enough of Morinomiya's shows!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I agree.
I'm curious to see what would happen if we tried that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, does that mean I'd look super cool if I played a male character?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. If you're curious, why don't you give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then... Ahem!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Ah, princess, your prince has arrived!
Let us attend that party and make merry together!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, that was really cool!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Why limit yourself to just cool roles?
I'd love to see you play an old man.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
An old man?
U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! How are we all doing today? Good? Make sure to give out plenty of snacks to everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure who you're playing...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But your character seems like a very jolly fellow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was really fun!
You guys should also try it♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think I'd like to play a prince.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Prince Luka?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can't imagine what that's going to be like!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Here goes nothing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Princess, the ball is starting. Come dance with me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha♪ That's just you being yourself, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Shouldn't a prince act more prim and proper?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I tried my best to do that, but I guess it wasn't enough.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. That doesn't make this activity any less interesting. Playing characters that we normally don't allows us to present a new side of ourselves.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It might be worth putting on a show using this format!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna give it a try!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too! I'm sure it's going to be wonderfully exciting!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We can even perform it for Tsukasa and the others once it's done!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I bet their jaws are gonna hit the floor☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, we should do our best to surprise them. So, let's start getting everything together, shall we?
